items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then you had Wyatt Ruther come in and play bass. / Yeah.

ctx.x: Now I knew him up in the Bay area so how did he get into your group?
I knew Wyatt. I mean, I’d seen, you know -­
Was he based in LA at that time? He must have been. I mean that would have been a heck of commute.
